caption: The drawing depicts a baby carriage with a cream-colored, oval-shaped body and a black canopy supported by four vertical rods. The carriage has a long, reddish-brown wooden handle extending from the front left side, ending in a crossbar, which appears to be used for pushing and steering. It stands on a chassis composed of reddish-brown and black wooden framework, featuring four large spoked wheels, also rendered in brown, with metallic axles at their centers. The spoked wheels have a slightly darker brown outline and visible structural details. The background is plain, untextured, and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. In the bottom right corner, the text "BABY CARRIAGE KS. MSC.1. 6 ROLLAND AYRES" is inscribed in small, black lettering.
title: Baby Carriage
